Hi Alyssa — thanks for sending the export and explanation. We analyzed the file and reconciled the spike to a routing key (ns-test-77) that generated 42.7M tokens during Dec 29-30. Our standard rate for those tokens per your plan would have been $0.00035/token which gives a gross one-off of $14,945.

Proposed adjustment:
- Validate 100% of the flagged usage as non-production and credit back 42.7M tokens at plan rate = $14,945 gross.
- Apply a 2.5% processing fee per our public terms (which would be $373).
- Net credit offered: $14,572 to be issued as a credit rollforward against the next monthly invoice or term.

I've attached a draft credit note (redwood_credit_note_D-8349.pdf).

Quick question for accounting: do you want the credit to appear as a line item on the Feb invoice (immediate offset) or a term-level balance to be consumed over the next 90 days?

Ben Carter
Senior Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
